{{Top}}
[[File:Anakinjabiim.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] use of the word.]]
{{Quote|Mooooom! Dad says you aren't allowed to say stang!|[[Ben Skywalker]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Stang''' was an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] swear word<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> popular among people of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used the word frequently during his and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] mission to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> Other notable [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Mara Jade Skywalker]],<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> her son [[Ben Skywalker]] and his cousin [[Jaina Solo Fel]] also used this word.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> 

The word was also used in phrases such as "one Stang of a time" (used to describe something difficult, e.g., "We'll have one Stang of a time getting them to surface again."),<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> "how the stang,"<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> "scare the stang out of,"<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> "whatever the stang," "what the stang,"<ref name="Sacrifice" /> "what the stinkin' stang,"<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> "where the stang"<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars novelization">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> and "who the stang."<ref name="O66" /> It could also be used as an idiom to show that a person did not care about someone, such as, "Stang the kid anyway."<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> The variant "stanging" could be used as a derogatory modifier, such as, "[[King/Legends|queen]] of the stanging [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]."<ref name="Sacrifice" />
{{Stub}}
